Guessing doesn't work

THE COMPLETE PROGRAM
How Sensify works.
A structured system that takes you from suspecting a food trigger to having your verdicts: a personal, evidence-based ruling on every tested food.
SETUP
Before the protocol begins.
ONE TIME
STEP 1
Complete your intake survey
Tell us about your symptoms and rate your baseline severity on a 1 to 10 scale. This becomes the comparison point for every improvement throughout your program. You also tell us how often you eat common foods, so we know your habits before your lab results even arrive.
STEP 2
Complete your lab test from home
Your lab test is part of the $399, so there is no separate lab bill. You complete it from home, with no clinic visits, and if you already have recent results you can use those instead.
STEP 3
Upload your results, read instantly
Upload your lab PDF, take a photo, or enter results manually. Every flagged food is extracted and categorized as High, Moderate, or Low sensitivity, then cross-referenced with your eating habits to build your elimination list. You review and confirm before anything starts.
ELIMINATION
Eight weeks of clean signal.
MONTHS 1–2
DAILY
Daily check-in, about 30 seconds
Each day you log sleep, stress, hydration, whether you stayed on plan, and anything your body did. Staying on plan builds your streak, and an honest slip never counts against you. Every entry feeds a system that is learning your patterns.
WEEKLY
Weekly symptom check-in
Every 7 days a check-in appears on your dashboard. Takes about 2 minutes. Rate your symptoms on a 1 to 10 scale, with questions personalized to your intake. Submit and a personalized insight is generated from your symptom trend, compliance, and baseline, and it sharpens every week.
ALWAYS ON
Sensify learns you
Behind the check-ins, a pattern engine is building your personal baseline: how often symptoms show up on clean weeks, how your sleep and stress move with how you feel. By week 4 it starts cross-referencing, and everything it learns is weighed when your verdicts are decided, so a food never gets blamed for what your sleep did.
IF NEEDED
Compliance support, if you hit a wall
If staying on plan gets hard, you tell us what's toughest, cravings, social situations, hidden ingredients, cost, and the app responds with specific guidance for your situation. Every case is reviewed personally, by the founder, before any plan recommendation is made.
REINTRODUCTION
Where you get your answers.
MONTHS 2–6
ORDERED
Your testing order is decided, not random
The foods you eat most often are tested first, because they matter most to your daily life. Among equals, your strongest lab suspects go ahead. You can always override the order and pick any food yourself.
14 DAYS EACH
Each food gets a structured 14-day cycle
Three days eating the food as you normally would, then eleven days off to let symptoms settle. This exposure-washout pattern is modeled on the clinical elimination-diet standard for isolating how a single food affects you.
ONE 14-DAY CYCLE
Exposure (days 1–3)
Washout (days 4–14)
DAY 14
Get your verdict
Your daily logs across the cycle produce a verdict: Safe, Limit, or Avoid. Each one is entered in your verdicts. No food gets labeled without real evidence from your own body.
END OF PROGRAM
Receive your verdicts
By the end, every tested food is categorized by real symptom evidence. Safe, Limit, Avoid, all earned. Your verdicts are personal and yours to keep. You can continue with Maintain, which keeps your verdicts working for you every day with Ask Sensify always on hand.

The complete system is $399, lab test included. Nothing else to buy.

THE SCIENCE
Your lab test is a hypothesis.
Your body gives the verdict.
IgG tests measure exposure, not reaction. A high reading for eggs might just mean you eat eggs every day. Sensify confirms what's real by testing it in your actual life.
THE DIFFERENCE THAT MATTERS
THE LAB TEST
A hypothesis
Measures how much your immune system has been exposed to a food. Flags what's worth investigating. It cannot tell you what's actually causing your symptoms.
→
SENSIFY
A verdict
Removes and reintroduces each flagged food in real life, tracks your response daily, and confirms the truth: Safe, Limit, or Avoid.
WHY THE METHOD WORKS
Built on the method clinicians actually use.
Elimination & reintroduction
The standard clinical approach for identifying food triggers, used by gastroenterologists and dietitians to separate real reactions from suspicion.
14-day reintroduction cycles
Each food is reintroduced for 3 days then removed for 11. This exposure-washout pattern isolates symptom responses with enough signal to draw reliable conclusions.
Daily compliance tracking
Daily check-ins give seven data points per week instead of one. That resolution makes it possible to spot patterns, like symptoms spiking the day after a slip-up, that weekly surveys miss entirely.
Built on the clinical standard
Our elimination timelines and reintroduction structure follow the clinical elimination diet method: the same structured approach dietitians have used for decades.
ESTABLISHED METHOD
WHAT YOU WALK AWAY WITH
An answer either way.
Most people who suspect food never get certainty. They cut things out, feel unsure, and second-guess forever. The protocol ends that. If a food is a trigger, you will know. And if your body turns out to tolerate everything well, you will know that too, with the same confidence. That is not a disappointing result. It means food is not the thing holding you back, which saves you years of needless restriction and tells you where to look instead. We will never invent a problem to justify the program. The honest answer is the whole point.
A PATH FOR EVERY RESULT
Whatever your results show, you're not left guessing.
1
Your lab flags foods
We build your protocol around the specific foods your panel flagged, testing each one through elimination and reintroduction to confirm which actually affect you.
2
Clean panel, real symptoms
A clean panel doesn't mean nothing's wrong. Many real triggers, especially digestive ones, never show up on a lab. So we test the most common culprits directly, and you choose how thorough to go.
3
Food isn't the issue
If your panel is clean and your symptoms are minimal, the honest answer may be that food isn't your problem. That's valuable to know, and we'll tell you plainly rather than run you through a protocol with nothing to find.
Human review for plan changes
Insights are generated automatically, but any recommendation to change your protocol is personally reviewed first. No automated plan decisions that bypass human judgment.
A wellness program, not a diagnosis
Sensify is an educational wellness tool. It does not diagnose, treat, or cure any condition. Always consult a healthcare provider for serious or concerning symptoms.

OUR STORY
I spent years guessing.
Sensify exists so you don't have to.
Years of feeling off, a drawer of half-read lab reports, and nobody who could say which food was actually the problem. This company started as a stubborn refusal to keep guessing.
01 · THE GUESSING
Cutting foods at random
Dropping dairy one month, gluten the next. Feeling slightly better, never knowing why, always drifting back. No structure, no signal, no answer.
02 · THE TEST
A list, then silence
The lab flagged a page of foods and handed over nothing else. No protocol, no guidance, no way to know which flags were real. A list is not an answer.
03 · THE SYSTEM
Running it properly
A real elimination. Foods tested back one at a time, logged daily, judged on evidence. It worked, and it was brutal to run alone. That became the product.
The test was easy to buy. The answer took a system. So I built the system.
Every verdict we issue is the one we never got.
Sensify exists to turn a suspicion into a ruling: Safe, Limit, or Avoid, earned from your own body's evidence. No guessing. No drifting back.
